name: Hydrogen - ഹൈഡ്രജൻ
summary: Hydrogen is the lightest element and the most abundant chemical substance in the universe.

name: Helium - 	 ഹീ­ലിയം
summary: Helium is a colorless, odorless, tasteless, non-toxic, inert, monatomic gas that heads the noble gas group in the periodic table.

name: Lithium - ലിഥിയം
summary: Lithium is a soft, silvery-white alkali metal. Under standard conditions, it is the lightest metal and the lightest solid element.

name: Beryllium - ബെറിലിയം
summary: Beryllium is a relatively rare element in the universe. It is a divalent element which occurs naturally only in combination with other elements.

name: Boron - ബോറോൺ
summary: Boron is a chemical element with symbol B and atomic number 5. It is a low-abundance element that is present in the Earth crust.

name: Carbon - കാർബൺ
summary: Carbon is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent bonds.

name: Nitrogen - നൈട്രജൻ
summary: Nitrogen is a chemical element with symbol N and atomic number 7. It is the lightest member of group 15 of the periodic table.

name: Oxygen - ഓക്സിജൻ
summary: Oxygen is a chemical element with symbol O and atomic number 8. It is a member of the chalcogen group on the periodic table.

name: Fluorine - ഫ്ലൂറിൻ
summary: Fluorine is a chemical element with symbol F and atomic number 9. It is the lightest halogen and exists as a highly toxic pale yellow diatomic gas at standard conditions.

name: Neon - നിയോൺ
summary: Neon is a chemical element with symbol Ne and atomic number 10. It is a noble gas.

name: Sodium - സോഡിയം
summary: Sodium is a chemical element with symbol Na and atomic number 11. It is a soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal.

name: Magnesium - മഗ്നീഷ്യം
summary: Magnesium is a chemical element with symbol Mg and atomic number 12. It is a shiny gray solid which bears a close physical resemblance to the other five elements in the second column of the periodic table.

name: Aluminum - അലൂമിനിയം
summary: Aluminium is a chemical element with symbol Al and atomic number 13. It is a silvery-white, soft, nonmagnetic, ductile metal.

name: Silicon - സിലിക്കൺ
summary: Silicon is a chemical element with symbol Si and atomic number 14. It is a hard and brittle crystalline solid with a blue-grey metallic lustre.

name: Phosphorus - ഫോസ്ഫറസ്
summary: Phosphorus is a chemical element with symbol P and atomic number 15. As an element, phosphorus exists in two major forms—white phosphorus and red phosphorus.

name: Sulfur - സൾഫർ
summary: Sulfur or sulphur is a chemical element with symbol S and atomic number 16. It is abundant, multivalent, and nonmetallic.

name: Chlorine - ക്ലോറിൻ
summary: Chlorine is a chemical element with symbol Cl and atomic number 17. It is the second-lightest of the halogens.

name: Argon - ആർഗോൺ
summary: Argon is a chemical element with symbol Ar and atomic number 18. It is in group 18 of the periodic table and is a noble gas.

name: Potassium - പൊട്ടാസ്യം
summary: Potassium is a chemical element with symbol K and atomic number 19. It was first isolated from potash, the ashes of plants, from which its name derives.

name: Calcium - കാത്സ്യം
summary: Calcium is a chemical element with symbol Ca and atomic number 20. Calcium is a soft gray alkaline earth metal, fifth-most-abundant element by mass in the Earth crust.

name: Scandium - സ്കാൻഡിയം
summary: Scandium is a chemical element with symbol Sc and atomic number 21. A silvery-white metallic d-block element, it has historically been classified as a rare earth element.

name: Titanium - ടൈറ്റാനിയം
summary: Titanium is a chemical element with symbol Ti and atomic number 22. It is a lustrous transition metal with a silver color, low density, and high strength.

name: Vanadium - വനേഡിയം
summary: Vanadium is a chemical element with symbol V and atomic number 23. It is a hard, silvery grey, ductile, and malleable transition metal.

name: Chromium - ക്രോമിയം
summary: Chromium is a chemical element with symbol Cr and atomic number 24. It is the first element in group 6.

name: Manganese - മാംഗനീസ്
summary: Manganese is a chemical element with symbol Mn and atomic number 25. It is not found as a free element in nature.

name: Iron - അയൺ
summary: Iron is a chemical element with symbol Fe and atomic number 26. It is a metal in the first transition series.

name: Cobalt - കൊബാൾട്ട്
summary: Cobalt is a chemical element with symbol Co and atomic number 27. Like nickel, cobalt is found in the Earth crust only in chemically combined form.

name: Nickel - നിക്കൽ
summary: Nickel is a chemical element with symbol Ni and atomic number 28. It is a silvery-white lustrous metal with a slight golden tinge.

name: Copper - കോപ്പർ
summary: Copper is a chemical element with symbol Cu and atomic number 29. It is a soft, malleable, and ductile metal with very high thermal and electrical conductivity.

name: Zinc - സിങ്ക്
summary: Zinc is a chemical element with symbol Zn and atomic number 30. It is the first element in group 12 of the periodic table.

name: Gallium - ഗാലിയം
summary: Gallium is a chemical element with symbol Ga and atomic number 31. It is in group 13 of the periodic table, and thus has similarities to the other metals of the group, aluminium, indium, and thallium.

name: Germanium - ജർമേനിയം
summary: Germanium is a chemical element with symbol Ge and atomic number 32. It is a lustrous, hard, grayish-white metalloid in the carbon group.

name: Arsenic - ആർസെനിക്
summary: Arsenic is a chemical element with symbol As and atomic number 33. Arsenic occurs in many minerals, usually in combination with sulfur and metals.

name: Selenium - സെലീനിയം
summary: Selenium is a chemical element with symbol Se and atomic number 34. It is a nonmetal with properties that are intermediate between the elements above and below in the periodic table, sulfur and tellurium.

name: Bromine - ബ്രോമിൻ
summary: Bromine is a chemical element with symbol Br and atomic number 35. It is a halogen. The element was isolated independently by two chemists, Carl Jacob Löwig and Antoine Jérôme Balard, in 1825–1826.

name: Krypton - ക്രിപ്റ്റോൺ
summary: Krypton is a chemical element with symbol Kr and atomic number 36. It is a member of group 18 elements.

name: Rubidium - റൂബിഡിയം
summary: Rubidium is a chemical element with symbol Rb and atomic number 37. Rubidium is a soft, silvery-white metallic element of the alkali metal group, with a standard atomic weight of 85.4678.

name: Strontium - സ്ട്രോൺഷ്യം
summary: Strontium is a chemical element with symbol Sr and atomic number 38. An alkaline earth metal, strontium is a soft silver-white or yellowish metallic element that is highly chemically reactive.

name: Yttrium - യിട്രിയം
summary: Yttrium is a chemical element with symbol Y and atomic number 39. It is a silvery-metallic transition metal chemically similar to the lanthanides and has often been classified as a rare earth element.

name: Zirconium - സിർക്കോണിയം
summary: Zirconium is a chemical element with symbol Zr and atomic number 40. The name of zirconium is taken from the name of the mineral zircon, the most important source of zirconium.

name: Niobium - നിയോബിയം
summary: Niobium, formerly columbium, is a chemical element with symbol Nb and atomic number 41. It is a soft, grey, ductile transition metal, often found in the pyrochlore mineral.

name: Molybdenum - മോളിബ്ഡിനം
summary: Molybdenum is a chemical element with symbol Mo and atomic number 42. The name is from Neo-Latin molybdaenum, from Ancient Greek Μόλυβδος molybdos, meaning lead, since its ores were confused with lead ores.

name: Technetium - ടെക്നീഷ്യം
summary: Technetium is a chemical element with symbol Tc and atomic number 43. It is the lightest element whose isotopes are all radioactive; none are stable.

name: Ruthenium - റുഥീനിയം
summary: Ruthenium is a chemical element with symbol Ru and atomic number 44. It is a rare transition metal belonging to the platinum group of the periodic table.

name: Rhodium - റോഡിയം
summary: Rhodium is a chemical element with symbol Rh and atomic number 45. It is a rare, silvery-white, hard, corrosion-resistant and chemically inert transition metal.

name: Palladium - പലേഡിയം
summary: Palladium is a chemical element with symbol Pd and atomic number 46. It is a rare and lustrous silvery-white metal discovered in 1803 by William Hyde Wollaston.

name: Silver - സിൽവർ
summary: Silver is a chemical element with symbol Ag and atomic number 47. A soft, white, lustrous transition metal, it exhibits the highest electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity, and reflectivity of any metal.

name: Cadmium - കാഡ്മിയം
summary: Cadmium is a chemical element with symbol Cd and atomic number 48. This soft, bluish-white metal is chemically similar to the two other stable metals in group 12, zinc and mercury.

name: Indium - ഇൻഡിയം
summary: Indium is a chemical element with symbol In and atomic number 49. It is a post-transition metallic element that is rare in Earth crust.

name: Tin - ടിൻ
summary: Tin is a chemical element with the symbol Sn and atomic number 50, is a post-transition metal in group 14 of the periodic table.

name: Antimony - ആന്റിമണി
summary: Antimony is a chemical element with symbol Sb and atomic number 51. A lustrous gray metalloid, it is found in nature mainly as the sulfide mineral stibnite.

name: Tellurium - ടെലൂറിയം
summary: Tellurium is a chemical element with symbol Te and atomic number 52. It is a brittle, mildly toxic, rare, silver-white metalloid.

name: Iodine - അയഡിൻ
summary: Iodine is a chemical element with symbol I and atomic number 53. The name is from Greek ἰοειδής ioeidēs, meaning violet or purple, due to the color of elemental iodine vapor.

name: Xenon - സെനോൺ
summary: Xenon is a chemical element with symbol Xe and atomic number 54. It is a colorless, dense, odorless noble gas found in the Earth atmosphere in trace amounts.

name: Caesium - സീസിയം
summary: Caesium or cesium is a chemical element with symbol Cs and atomic number 55. It is a soft, silvery-gold alkali metal with a melting point of 28.5 °C.

name: Barium - ബേരിയം
summary: Barium is a chemical element with symbol Ba and atomic number 56. It is the fifth element in group 2 and is a soft, silvery alkaline earth metal.

name: Lanthanum - ലാന്ഥനം
summary: Lanthanum is a chemical element with symbol La and atomic number 57. It is a soft, ductile, silvery-white metal that tarnishes rapidly when exposed to air and is soft enough to be cut with a knife.

name: Cerium - സീറിയം
summary: Cerium is a chemical element with symbol Ce and atomic number 58. It is a soft, silvery, ductile metal which easily oxidizes in air.

name: Praseodymium - പ്രസിയോഡൈമിയം
summary: Praseodymium is a chemical element with symbol Pr and atomic number 59. It is the third member of the lanthanide series and is traditionally considered to be one of the rare-earth metals.

name: Neodymium - നിയോഡിമിയം
summary: Neodymium is a chemical element with symbol Nd and atomic number 60. It is a soft silvery metal that tarnishes in air.

name: Promethium - പ്രൊമിഥിയം
summary: Promethium, originally prometheum, is a chemical element with the symbol Pm and atomic number 61.All of its isotopes are radioactive.

name: Samarium - സമേറിയം
summary: Samarium is a chemical element with symbol Sm and atomic number 62. It is a moderately hard silvery metal that slowly oxidizes in air.

name: Europium - യൂറോപ്പിയം
summary: Europium is a chemical element with symbol Eu and atomic number 63. It was isolated in 1901 and is named after the continent of Europe.

name: Gadolinium - ഗഡോലിനിയം
summary: Gadolinium is a chemical element with symbol Gd and atomic number 64. It is a silvery-white, malleable and ductile rare-earth metal.

name: Terbium - ടെർബിയം
summary: Terbium is a chemical element with symbol Tb and atomic number 65. It is a silvery-white, rare earth metal that is malleable, ductile, and soft enough to be cut with a knife.

name: Dysprosium - ഡിസ്പ്രോസിയം
summary: Dysprosium is a chemical element with the symbol Dy and atomic number 66. It is a rare earth element with a metallic silver luster.

name: Holmium - ഹോൾമിയം
summary: Holmium is a chemical element with symbol Ho and atomic number 67. Part of the lanthanide series, holmium is a rare earth element.

name: Erbium - എർബിയം
summary: Erbium is a chemical element with symbol Er and atomic number 68. A silvery-white solid metal when artificially isolated, natural erbium is always found in chemical combination with other elements.

name: Thulium - തൂലിയം
summary: Thulium is a chemical element with symbol Tm and atomic number 69. It is the thirteenth and third-last element in the lanthanide series.

name: Ytterbium - ഇറ്റർബിയം
summary: Ytterbium is a chemical element with symbol Yb and atomic number 70. It is the fourteenth and penultimate element in the lanthanide series.

name: Lutetium - ലുട്ടീഷ്യം
summary: Lutetium is a chemical element with symbol Lu and atomic number 71. It is a silvery white metal, which resists corrosion in dry air, but not in moist air.

name: Hafnium - ഹാഫ്നിയം
summary: Hafnium is a chemical element with symbol Hf and atomic number 72. A lustrous, silvery gray, tetravalent transition metal, hafnium chemically resembles zirconium and is found in zirconium minerals.

name: Tantalum - ടാന്റലം
summary: Tantalum is a chemical element with symbol Ta and atomic number 73. Previously known as tantalium, its name comes from Tantalus, an antihero from Greek mythology.

name: Tungsten - ടങ്സ്റ്റൺ
summary: Tungsten, also known as wolfram, is a chemical element with symbol W and atomic number 74. The word tungsten comes from the Swedish language tung sten, which directly translates to heavy stone.

name: Rhenium - റീനിയം
summary: Rhenium is a chemical element with symbol Re and atomic number 75. It is a silvery-white, heavy, third-row transition metal in group 7 of the periodic table.

name: Osmium - ഓസ്മിയം
summary: Osmium is a chemical element with symbol Os and atomic number 76. It is a hard, brittle, bluish-white transition metal in the platinum group that is found as a trace element in alloys, mostly in platinum ores.

name: Iridium - ഇറിഡിയം
summary: Iridium is a chemical element with symbol Ir and atomic number 77. A very hard, brittle, silvery-white transition metal of the platinum group, iridium is generally credited with being the second densest element after osmium.

name: Platinum - പ്ലാറ്റിനം
summary: Platinum is a chemical element with symbol Pt and atomic number 78. It is a dense, malleable, ductile, highly unreactive, precious, silverish-white transition metal.

name: Gold - ഗോൾഡ്
summary: Gold is a chemical element with symbol Au and atomic number 79. In its purest form, it is a bright, slightly reddish yellow, dense, soft, malleable, and ductile metal.

name: Mercury -  മെർക്കുറി
summary: Mercury is a chemical element with symbol Hg and atomic number 80. It is commonly known as quicksilver and was formerly named hydrargyrum.

name: Thallium - താലിയം
summary: Thallium is a chemical element with symbol Tl and atomic number 81. This soft gray post-transition metal is not found free in nature.

name: Lead - ലെഡ്
summary: Lead is a chemical element with atomic number 82 and symbol Pb. It is a soft, malleable, and heavy post-transition metal.

name: Bismuth - ബിസ്മത്
summary: Bismuth is a chemical element with symbol Bi and atomic number 83. Bismuth, a pentavalent post-transition metal, chemically resembles arsenic and antimony.

name: Polonium - പൊളോണിയം
summary: Polonium is a chemical element with symbol Po and atomic number 84, discovered in 1898 by Marie Curie and Pierre Curie. A rare and highly radioactive element with no stable isotopes, polonium is chemically similar to bismuth and tellurium.

name: Astatine - അസ്റ്റാറ്റൈൻ
summary: Astatine is a very rare radioactive chemical element with the chemical symbol At and atomic number 85. It occurs on Earth as the decay product of various heavier elements.

name: Radon - റഡോൺ
summary: Radon is a chemical element with symbol Rn and atomic number 86. It is a radioactive, colorless, odorless, tasteless noble gas.

name: Francium - ഫ്രാൻസിയം
summary: Francium is a chemical element with symbol Fr and atomic number 87. It used to be known as eka-caesium and actinium K. It is the second-least electronegative element, behind only caesium.

name: Radium - റേഡിയം
summary: Radium is a chemical element with symbol Ra and atomic number 88. It is the sixth element in group 2 of the periodic table, also known as the alkaline earth metals.

name: Actinium - ആക്റ്റിനിയം
summary: Actinium is a chemical element with symbol Ac and atomic number 89. It was first isolated by Friedrich Oskar Giesel in 1902.

name: Thorium - തോറിയം
summary: Thorium is a chemical element with symbol Th and atomic number 90. A radioactive actinide metal, thorium is one of only four radioactive elements that still occur naturally in significant quantities as a primordial element.

name: Protactinium - പ്രൊട്ടക്റ്റിനിയം
summary: Protactinium is a chemical element with symbol Pa and atomic number 91. It is a dense, silvery-gray actinide metal which readily reacts with oxygen, water vapor and inorganic acids.

name: Uranium - യുറേനിയം
summary: Uranium is a chemical element with symbol U and atomic number 92. It is a silvery-white metal in the actinide series of the periodic table.

name: Neptunium - നെപ്റ്റ്യൂണിയം
summary: Neptunium is a chemical element with symbol Np and atomic number 93. A radioactive actinide metal, neptunium is the first transuranic element.

name: Plutonium - പ്ലൂട്ടോണിയം
summary: Plutonium is a transuranic radioactive chemical element with symbol Pu and atomic number 94. It is an actinide metal of silvery-gray appearance that tarnishes when exposed to air.

name: Americium - അമെരിസിയം
summary: Americium is a radioactive transuranic chemical element with symbol Am and atomic number 95. This member of the actinide series is located in the periodic table under the lanthanide element europium, and thus by analogy was named after the Americas.

name: Curium - ക്യൂറിയം
summary: Curium is a transuranic radioactive chemical element with symbol Cm and atomic number 96. This element of the actinide series was named after Marie and Pierre Curie – both were known for their research on radioactivity.

name: Berkelium - ബെർക്കിലിയം
summary: Berkelium is a transuranic radioactive chemical element with symbol Bk and atomic number 97. It is a member of the actinide and transuranium element series.

name: Californium - കാലിഫോർണിയം
summary: Californium is a radioactive metallic chemical element with symbol Cf and atomic number 98. The element was first made in 1950 at the University of California Radiation Laboratory in Berkeley.

name: Einsteinium - ഐൻസ്റ്റൈനിയം
summary: Einsteinium is a synthetic element with symbol Es and atomic number 99. It is the seventh transuranic element, and an actinide.

name: Fermium - ഫെർമിയം
summary: Fermium is a synthetic element with symbol Fm and atomic number 100. It is a member of the actinide series. It is the heaviest element that can be formed by neutron bombardment of lighter elements.

name: Mendelevium - മെൻഡലീവിയം
summary: Mendelevium is a synthetic element with symbol Md and atomic number 101. A metallic radioactive transuranic element in the actinide series, it is the first element that currently cannot be produced in macroscopic quantities.

name: Nobelium - നൊബീലിയം
summary: Nobelium is a synthetic chemical element with symbol No and atomic number 102. It is named in honor of Alfred Nobel, the inventor of dynamite and benefactor of science.

name: Lawrencium - ലോറെൻസിയം
summary: Lawrencium is a synthetic chemical element with symbol Lr and atomic number 103. It is named in honor of Ernest Lawrence, inventor of the cyclotron, a device that was used to discover many artificial radioactive elements.

name: Rutherfordium - റുഥർഫോർഡിയം
summary: Rutherfordium is a chemical element with symbol Rf and atomic number 104, named in honor of physicist Ernest Rutherford. It is a synthetic element and radioactive.

name: Dubnium - ഡുബ്നിയം
summary: Dubnium is a chemical element with symbol Db and atomic number 105. It is named after the town of Dubna in Russia, where it was first produced.

name: Seaborgium - സീബോർഗിയം
summary: Seaborgium is a synthetic element with symbol Sg and atomic number 106. It is named after the American nuclear chemist Glenn T. Seaborg.

name: Bohrium - ബോറിയം
summary: Bohrium is a chemical element with symbol Bh and atomic number 107. It is named after Danish physicist Niels Bohr.

name: Hassium - ഹാസിയം
summary: Hassium is a chemical element with symbol Hs and atomic number 108. It is named after the German state of Hesse.

name: Meitnerium - മൈറ്റ്‌നെറിയം
summary: Meitnerium is a chemical element with symbol Mt and atomic number 109. It is named after Lise Meitner.

name: Darmstadtium - ഡാംസ്റ്റാഡ്ഷിയം
summary: Darmstadtium is a chemical element with symbol Ds and atomic number 110. It is named after Darmstadt, Germany, where it was discovered.

name: Roentgenium - റോൺജെനിയം
summary: Roentgenium is a chemical element with symbol Rg and atomic number 111. It is named after Wilhelm Conrad Röntgen, who discovered X-rays.

name: Copernicium - കോപ്പർനിസിയം
summary: Copernicium is a chemical element with symbol Cn and atomic number 112. It is named after astronomer Nicolaus Copernicus.

name: Nihonium - നിഹോണിയം
summary: Nihonium is a chemical element with symbol Nh and atomic number 113. It was discovered by a Japanese team at RIKEN and named after Japan.

name: Flerovium - ഫ്ലെറോവിയം
summary: Flerovium is a superheavy artificial chemical element with symbol Fl and atomic number 114. It is named after the Flerov Laboratory of Nuclear Reactions of the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research in Dubna, Russia.

name: Moscovium - മോസ്കോവിയം
summary: Moscovium is the name of a synthetic superheavy element with symbol Mc and atomic number 115. It was named after the Moscow Oblast, where the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research is located.

name: Livermorium - ലിവെർമോറിയം
summary: Livermorium is a synthetic superheavy element with symbol Lv and atomic number 116. It is named after the Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory in the United States.

name: Tennessine - റ്റെന്നെസ്സീൻ
summary: Tennessine is a synthetic chemical element with symbol Ts and atomic number 117. It is named after the U.S. state of Tennessee.

name: Oganesson - ഒഗനെസ്സോൺ
summary: Oganesson is a synthetic chemical element with symbol Og and atomic number 118. It was named after Yuri Oganessian, a Russian nuclear physicist.
